players.product: Copper surface-treatment / plating chemicals for package substrates (Samsung Electro-Mechanics supplier)

quarterly_data.quarter: MEC press release: Notice Regarding Additional Capital Investment (Acquisition (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MEC decided on additional capital investment of approx. JPY 2 billion - the second phase of construction of its new Kitakyushu Factory, which is scheduled to begin operations in December 2026 - to strengthen facilities that will produce chemical products for semiconductor package substrates, with start of operation planned for FY2028, financed by own funds and borrowings (planned). The company had planned to raise the new factory's capacity as needed, but says that against the backdrop of increased AI-related investment, demand for products related to semiconductor package substrates is expected to greatly increase, particularly for the company, so it is investing beyond the scope of the original plan; the investment also aims to strengthen its business continuity plan by decentralizing production bases. Impact on results for the fiscal year ending December 2026 is described as immaterial.
quarterly_data.figure: Approx. JPY 2 billion second-phase capex at Kitakyushu Factory; factory operations start December 2026; second phase start of operation FY2028 (planned)
